events.title: GNSS_DEGRADED
events.detail: Position innovation is rising above the trust gate.
events.mitigation: Increase GNSS covariance and prepare dead reckoning.

events.title: GNSS_DENIED
events.detail: No consistent fix is available for the estimator.
events.mitigation: Disable GNSS updates and continue with inertial aids.

events.title: SHOCK_DETECTED
events.detail: Short vibration impulse appears in the motion window.
events.mitigation: Inflate covariance and soften motion constraints for 3 s.

events.title: ROAD_AMBIGUITY
events.detail: Two connected road hypotheses remain plausible.
events.mitigation: Keep both candidates and suspend map feedback.

events.title: GNSS_FIX_REJECTED
events.detail: First returned fix fails the consistency gate.
events.mitigation: Remain in reacquisition and wait for consistent fixes.

events.title: GNSS_REACQUIRING
events.detail: Returned fixes agree with the inertial state.
events.mitigation: Accept with high covariance and observe three fixes.

events.title: GNSS_TRUSTED
events.detail: Multiple consistent fixes passed integrity checks.
events.mitigation: Restore normal fusion and reduce covariance gradually.
